name: Virtual assistant price index
how_to_cite: MyRemoteVA, Virtual assistant price index, version 2026-11, https://myremoteva.com/va-price-index
notes: Provider rows record what each provider shows on its own public pricing page on the date read. Prices change; check the provider page before you buy.
Where a provider shows a monthly price and hours but no hourly rate, usd_per_hour is our arithmetic (price divided by hours) and the basis column says so.
Price per hour is not a quality score. Task scope, review, location and commitment differ between providers.
MyRemoteVA rows come from the current published price list (data/plans.php on myremoteva.com). Quarterly plans bill every 3 months.
The hours-to-cost file is MyRemoteVA arithmetic: the lowest-cost combination of monthly plans that covers the hours (quarterly plans excluded).
